globalStateSetup.description: CRITICAL: Before capturing ANY analytics screenshots, must select 'This Year' preset and click Search to load mock data. Data persists across all tab switches.

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-filters
screenshots.description: Warehouse Analytics page showing the global filter bar with date range, department and group selectors, and quick preset buttons
screenshots.desiredState: Analytics page loaded with This Year preset selected and Search executed — filter bar visible at top
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the filter bar area — date range, preset pills, department/group selectors — BEFORE switching any tabs

stateSetup.description: Select This Year preset and click Search to load data

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-balance
screenshots.description: Balance Movement table with color-coded column groups showing opening balance, inflows, outflows, and closing balance
screenshots.desiredState: Balance tab active (value='balance') showing movement table with data loaded
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the balance movement table — the default/first analytics tab

stateSetup.description: Data should already be loaded from globalStateSetup. Click balance tab if not already active.

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-insights
screenshots.description: Insights tab showing top items by value, movement summary, period comparison, and department activity
screenshots.desiredState: Insights tab active (value='insights') showing analytical insights panels
screenshots.differentiator: Shows insights dashboard panels — NOT balance table or other specific analysis tabs

mustShow: Insight panels or cards with data

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-dead-stock
screenshots.description: Dead Stock table showing items with zero movement and 'Never Moved' badges
screenshots.desiredState: Dead Stock tab active (value='deadstock') showing zero-movement items
screenshots.differentiator: Shows dead stock analysis — items with NO movement, NOT low stock

mustShow: Never Moved or zero movement badges

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-low-stock
screenshots.description: Low Stock table with color-coded Days of Supply column showing red, yellow, and green indicators
screenshots.desiredState: Low Stock tab active (value='lowstock') showing items with low supply levels
screenshots.differentiator: Shows LOW stock (still has some) — NOT dead stock (zero movement)

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-abc-xyz
screenshots.description: ABC/XYZ interactive 3x3 classification matrix with color-coded cells showing item count and total spend
screenshots.desiredState: ABC/XYZ tab active (value='abcxyz') showing the classification matrix grid
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the 3x3 ABC/XYZ matrix — a unique grid visualization, NOT a standard table

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-expiration
screenshots.description: Expiration Risk view with five color-coded time bucket cards and a drill-down table showing items approaching expiry
screenshots.desiredState: Expiration tab active (value='expiration') showing time bucket cards and expiry table
screenshots.differentiator: Shows expiration risk analysis with time bucket cards — NOT low stock or dead stock

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-suppliers
screenshots.description: Suppliers tab showing supplier scorecard table with ranked suppliers, delivery counts, total spend
screenshots.desiredState: Suppliers tab active (value='suppliers') showing supplier scorecard and related sections
screenshots.differentiator: Shows supplier analysis — scorecard table, stockout log, department cost, write-off analysis — may need scrolling
screenshots.knownLimitation: Tab has 4 sub-sections — may need scrolling to show all content

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-clinical-diagnosis
screenshots.description: Clinical Analytics showing Diagnosis Cost Analysis with expandable ICD-10 rows and outlier detection badges
screenshots.desiredState: Clinical tab active (value='clinical'), Diagnosis sub-tab showing cost analysis table
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Diagnosis Cost Analysis sub-tab — NOT the Lot Recall sub-tab

stateSetup.description: Switch to Clinical tab, ensure Diagnosis sub-tab is active

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-clinical-recall
screenshots.description: Clinical Analytics Lot Recall search with results card showing department breakdown and affected patients table
screenshots.desiredState: Clinical tab active, Lot Recall sub-tab showing recall search and results
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the Lot Recall sub-tab — NOT the Diagnosis Cost Analysis sub-tab

stateSetup.description: Switch to Clinical tab, then click Lot Recall sub-tab

screenshots.knownLimitation: May need to find correct sub-tab selector at capture time

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-budget
screenshots.description: Planning tab Budget vs Actual view with variance table showing over/under budget departments
screenshots.desiredState: Planning tab active (value='planning'), Budget sub-tab showing variance table
screenshots.differentiator: Shows Budget vs Actual sub-tab — NOT the Demand Forecast sub-tab

stateSetup.description: Switch to Planning tab, ensure Budget sub-tab is active

screenshots.name: wh-analytics-forecast
screenshots.description: Planning tab Demand Forecast with sparkline histograms showing consumption history and predicted quantities
screenshots.desiredState: Planning tab active, Forecast sub-tab showing demand prediction data
screenshots.differentiator: Shows Demand Forecast sub-tab — NOT the Budget vs Actual sub-tab

stateSetup.description: Switch to Planning tab, then click Forecast sub-tab

screenshots.knownLimitation: May need to find correct sub-tab selector at capture time

notes: MOST COMPLEX section. CRITICAL: Must select 'This Year' preset and click Search ONCE at start — data persists across all 9 tab switches. Clinical and Planning tabs each have 2 sub-tabs. Tab selectors use data-testid='analytics-tabs' container with value attributes.
